inspectionIntro.titleNamed: Welcome to {{apartmentName}}! Let’s get you settled.
inspectionIntro.titleDefault: Welcome to your stay! Let’s get you settled.
inspectionIntro.description: We want your stay to be completely worry-free. Before you unpack and relax, take 2 minutes to complete your arrival handover.

howItWorks.title: How it works & why it protects you
howItWorks.description: Your host took reference photos of the apartment right before your arrival. By taking a quick look through them, you confirm the condition of the space as you found it. This creates a fair, timestamped record for both you and your host—ensuring you’ll never be held responsible for pre-existing wear, marks, or missing items.

peaceOfMind.title: For Your Peace of Mind
peaceOfMind.description: Protects your deposit and establishes a timestamped record of the apartment's condition at check-in.

effortlessCheck.title: Effortless Room Check
effortlessCheck.description: Browse the host's photos room-by-room and flag a photo only if something doesn't match what you see.

roomFlowList.title: Explore your space
roomFlowList.subtitle: Take a quick tour around the apartment to see how everything is set up.
roomFlowList.description: Tap on any room to view the host's reference photos and make sure everything matches what you see in the space. Go through them room-by-room or jump around at your own pace.
